(Detailed Tender condition in Buyer uploaded ATC document) Scope of Work A. General Tender for Shifting, Installation and Commissioning of different capaciti es of VRLA compatible SMPS/ Li-ion Power Plant, Surge Protection Devic e (SPD) and its associated works at various GSM sites/exchange of subd ivisions at Kozhikode BA. 1. SCOPE OF WORK a. Dismantling of the battery set, shifting of the battery set, and installa tion of new battery sets. The tendered work involves the installation and commissioning of batte ry sets of different capacities (both VRLA and Lion battery sets capaciti

es 200 AH, 300AH, 400AH, 500AH, 600AH, 1000AH, 1500AH, 2000AH a nd 3000AH) at the existing indoor and outdoor BTS sites/exchange Koz hikode BA. The work also involves transportation of battery banks of diff erent capacities from BSNL location to various BTS sites/exchange and also dismantling of old batteries from BTS sites The scope of works shall broadly consist of following 1. New battery/old battery installation set including fixing of battery cab inet, battery case connecting DC cable, fuse and connecting earth 2. Ensure that all cable connecting legs are constructed from copper an d finished with a tinted protective coating 3.Dismantling of the battery set, including disconnection of power cabl es and all associated accessories, and shifting/relocation to the location (s) as instructed by the BSNL Officer-in Charge. 4.Transportation of the new Battery set to another BSNL site including l oading of the same Battery set to a suitable vehicle, unloading at the proposed site as per t he requirements. 5.Ensure proper handling during transportation by using adequate cove rings and designated vehicles to prevent damage or contamination 6.Installation of the Battery set, connecting HRC fuse, connecting earth for both battery set and battery set case testing and commissioning of the battery set on available exchange load. 7. Lifting UP/ DOWN the battery in multi-store buildings as per the req uirements. 8. Special care has been taken to avoid any damage to the building or other equipment during the shifting process. 9. Special care has been taken to ensure that the installation does not affect other equipment working. 10. AT should be done using artificial load only in order to prevent equi pment failures 11. Responsible for shifting the artificial load from the existing site/ex change to the newly installed site. 12. Appropriate health and safety precautions must be observed durin g all installation activities to prevent accidents, injuries, and exposure t o hazardous conditions 13. The vendor shall ensure that all employees, subcontractors, and la bor engaged in installation work are covered under comprehensive heal th insurance policies for the duration of the project. Proof of such insura

nce shall be provided to the client upon request A. Shifting of SMPS Power plants /installation of new SMPS Power plants The tendered work involves the installation and commissioning of VRL A compatible SMPS/Li-ion Power Plants of different capacities (below 400A, above 4 00A) and Surge Protection Device (SPD) at the existing indoor and outd oor BTS sites of Kozhikode BA. The work also involves transportation of Power plants (SMPS and Li-ion) of different capacities and its associated materials from BSNL Consignee Address to various BTS sites and also di smantling of old SMPS power plants from BTS sites /exchange. The bidd er/contractor has to assist the BSS team in conducting the Power plants (SMPS and Liion) A/T. The scope of works shall broadly consist of following 1. Installation of New SMPS/old SMPS including, installation of cabinet a nd connecting DC/AC cables ,fixing and connecting of SPD, fuse and ear th 2. Ensure that all cable connecting legs are constructed from copper an d finished with a tinted protective coating 3. Dismantling of SMPS including disconnecting both I/P and O/P Power cables along with all accessories and shifting/relocation to the location( s) as instructed by the BSNL Officer-in Charge. 4. Transportation of the SMPS to another BSNL site dismantling shifting & Loading of the same SMPS to a suitable vehicle, unloading & shifting as per the requirement. 5.Ensure proper handling during transportation by using adequate cove rings and designated vehicles to prevent damage or contamination 6. Installation of the SMPS, Laying I/P cables from L/T panel to SMPS, in stallation of Surge protection device, including ELCB with MOV, Connect ing Battery and DCDP cables, PE &Positive earth cables. Socket crimpin g on I/P, O/P & earth cables, Testing and Commissioning of the above S MPS on available exchange load as required. 7. Lifting UP/DOWN the SMPS power plants in multi storied buildings as per the requirements. 8.Special care has been taken to avoid any damage to the building or o ther equipment during the shifting process. 9. Special care has been taken to ensure that the installation does not affect other equipment working. 10. Special care has been taken to avoid any damage to the building or

other equipment during the shifting process 11. AT should be done using artificial load only in order to prevent equi pment failures 12.Responsible for shifting the artificial load from the existing site/exch ange to the newly installed site. 13. Appropriate health and safety precautions must be observed during all installation activities to prevent accidents, injuries, and expos ure to hazardous conditions 14. The vendor shall ensure that all employees, subcontractors, and la bor engaged in installation work are covered under comprehensive heal th insurance policies for the duration of the project. Proof of such insura nce shall be provided to the client upon request 3.TIME ALLOTTED FOR THE WORK The work should complete within 7 days from the date of issue of work order by the concerned Divisional Engineers and it should be completed strictly as per the time-frame. 4. GENERAL CONDITIONS 1.All the tools should be got arranged by the contractor/supplier at his cost. 2. All connecting materials such as legs, screws, and bolts shall be arr anged by the contractor/supplier at their own cost. 3.Transportation of Batteries & Power plants to BTS sites/exchange The transportation of batteries is required to be carried out by the con tractor/bidder. Utmost cares hall be taken to ensure that the batteries a re transported safely and any packing/additional packing required shall be provided. The contractor/bidder is required to transport the battery/ Power plant from individual sites/exchange for installation 5. Handing Over of completed Works The works ordered on the contractor/supplier shall be completed within the time prescribed in the WORK ORDER and the same shall be handed over to the SDE/JTO-in charge of the site duly recording the date of such completion. The date thus recorded will be taken for calculation of any delay incurred for the purpose of calculation of penalties/Liquidated Da mages as applicable as per the relevant terms and conditions. 6. Acceptance Testing The acceptance testing will be under taken by BSNL, but all the requir

ed manual assistance at the site/exchange shall be provided by the con tractor/supplier if the acceptance testing is carried out within two mont hs of handing over of the completed works to BSNL. After installation if any damages/ performance of the battery is found deteriorated within 3 months of installation, the vendor shall be responsible for replacement/rectification as the case may be 7. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS The detailed scope of the works involved in the Tender is given below. A Installation & Commissioning of Battery for indoor & outdoor BTSs/ex change. 1.The work involves installation of battery bank/banks connecting the b atteries to the power plant and extending earths to batteries. 2. The battery set of any capacity along with all the associated accesso ries shall be installed as per the installation procedure of the respective manufacturer and instructions of BSNL. Batteries have to be handled wi th extreme care and shall be positioned appropriately so that their larg e weight does not damage the floor. Additional support, below the shelt er floor, as required shall be provided in the case of installations inside prefab shelters so that there is no risk of floor sinking at a later stage d ue to the weight of the battery banks. 3.The initial freshening charge and discharge should be done strictly ac cording to the specification of the manufacturer. 4. Interconnections with power plant using cable of suitable gauge shall only be used. Interconnections with power plant should be properly don e. Appropriate crimping tools should be used to ensure proper contacts. Insulation tapes of the same colouring of the cable installation should b e wound at the lugged places so that all the exposed places other than what is essential to make proper contact are fully and securely insulate d. 5. Cut off switch/ isolation point (with proper tools such as extractors et c.) for both positive and negative terminations are to be provided for ea ch battery set. The body of the battery stand shall be earthed properly f rom the common earth point. The alignment and levelling of battery set s shall be properly done. 6.There should not be any damage to the battery cell(s). All inter linkin g nuts and bolts, lugs should be firmly tightened and fine quality grease

should be applied for avoiding rusting. The details of installation of batt ery like Capacity, Date of commissioning, etc. should be labelled as per the direction of the BSNL Engineer-in-charge. Polarity sign writings shou ld be made. Cell identification numbering is to be done. 7. Battery, stand, connecting links, DC cables, will be supplied by BSNL. All other materials for the work are to be arranged by the contrac tor/supplier. 8. In the case of dismantling of battery bank/banks there should not be any damage to the battery cell(s). All interlinking nuts and bolts, lugs should be loosened and removed carefully. All the dismantled items should be packed for transportation to the new site for redeployment. D ismantling & packing should be done as per the direction of the BSNL E ngineer-in-charge. B. Installation & Commissioning of SMPS/Li-ion Power plants for indoor & outdoor BTSs/exchange. 1.The work involves installation of SMPS/ Li-ion Power plants and extend ing earths to SMPS/Li-ion Power plants. 2.The SMPS/ Li-ion Power plants set of any capacity along with all the a ssociated accessories shall be Installed as per the installation procedure of the respective manufacturer and instructions of BSNL.SMP S/Li-ion Power plants have to be handled with extreme care and shall b e positioned appropriately so that their large weight does not damage t he floor. Additional support, below the shelter floor, as required shall be provided in the case of installations inside prefab shelters so that there is no risk of floor sinking at a later stage due to the weight of the SMPS/ Li-ion Power plants. 3. Inter connections with power plant using cable of suitable gauge shal l only be used. Interconnections with power plant should be properly do ne. Appropriate crimping tools should be used to ensure proper contact s. Insulation tapes of the same colouring of the cable installation should be wound at the lugged places so that all the exposed places other than what is essential to make proper contact are fully and securely ins ulated. 4. Cut off switch/ isolation point (with proper tools such as extractors et c.) for both positive and negative terminations are to be provided for S MPS/Li-ion Power plants. The body of the SMPS/Li-ion Power plants stan d shall be earthed properly from the common earth point. The alignmen t and levelling of SMPS/Li-ion Power plants sets shall be properly done. 5. The details of installation of SMPS/Li-ion Power plants like Capacity, Date of commissioning, etc. should be labelled as per the direction of th e BSNL Engineer-in-charge.

6. SMPS/Li-ion Power plants, SPDDC cables, will be supplied by BSNL. All other materials for the work are to be arranged by the Contractor/suppli er. 7. In the case of dismantling of SMPS/Li-ion Power plants there should n ot be any damage to the battery cell(s). All the dismantled items should be packed for transportation to the new site for redeployment. Dismantl ing & packing should be done as per the direction of the BSNL Engineer-in-charge. 8.
